parameters.content:
Schedule Trigger
Fires daily at 8:30 AM IST

Get all rows from Google Sheet
Loads every policy record
for processing

Block Check + Date Calculator
Blocked: lapsed, cancelled, withdrawn,
expired, void, terminated,
non-renewal, endorsement

Policy Status Node
NEW: 'active' only assigned when
transaction is active/new/renewal
AND _blocked is false
NEW: 'inactive' for allowed type
but blocked for another reason

Update Sheet
Writes day_90, day_60, day_30
and Policy Status back to sheet
for every row every day

Three parallel Check nodes
NEW: Each now ALSO checks
Policy Status === 'active'
Prevents emails to non-active
even if _blocked slips through

90/60/30-DAY PATH
If today = day_90/60/30
AND Policy Status = 'active'
AND not blocked
AND email_sent != Sent
→ Send plain text email + Mark Sent
